history.body: Hi, I’m looking at Pearl Residences because we’re hoping to buy somewhere around Seberang Jaya. Could you tell me what the 3-bedroom units are like and roughly what the monthly costs would be?

Hi! The Phase 1 three-bedroom is Type A: 900 sq ft, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The living, dining and kitchen areas are open-plan, and the layout avoids a long internal corridor, helping use the space efficiently. Maintenance is RM0.18 per sq ft inclusive of sinking fund—about RM162 a month for 900 sq ft, subject to latest confirmation. That’s maintenance only; utilities and any loan instalment are separate, and selected clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use. When you say monthly costs, are you mainly checking maintenance or would you like to consider the loan instalment too?

I’m trying to understand both, especially the loan instalment alongside the regular charges. We’re hoping to buy somewhere around Seberang Jaya, so could you also let me know the current price for Type A and whether a car park is included?

The regular maintenance for the 900 sq ft unit is about RM162 a month; utilities and any pay-per-use clubhouse charges are separate. I need to confirm the latest Type A price and the exact car-park allocation, as these can vary by unit and current package. I don’t want to give you a misleading price or say a car park is included before checking. The loan instalment will depend on the confirmed price and your financing terms; once the price is confirmed, I can help estimate it alongside the regular charges.
